column1: # Candidate models for the Bedrock driver lanes, one row per (lane, model).
# Columns (tab-separated, header row below this comment block):
#   nickname   that config's [models.<nickname>] key; a driver passes it as
#   upstream   the provider-side model or inference-profile id
#   tier       primary = the one model per lane that runs every case;
#              sweep = runs the small sweep case set
#   thinking   yes = the model's AWS doc page lists reasoning support, so
#              the sweep includes a streaming thinking case
# Lines starting with `#` are comments. Every upstream id below appears on
# a `# doc` line naming the AWS model card it was taken from; the regions
# and inference options were taken from the per-model tables on
# (all read 2026-10-12). Invoke/Converse rows are bedrock-runtime ids
# callable from us-west-2 (in-Region, `us.` geo, or `global.` profile);
# mantle rows are bare ids served in-Region on bedrock-mantle in us-east-1.
# Lane configs and this file are welded by
